name: pnp-powerplatform-snippets-brick-club-responsive-header
title: Brick Club Responsive Header
shortDescription: A responsive Power Apps navigation header with desktop buttons, a compact dropdown, and active-page highlighting.
longDescription: An example of a responsive header for Power Apps canvas apps that adapts from navigation buttons on wider layouts to a compact dropdown on smaller screens. Customize the title, logo, subtitle, and navigation to match your app. Includes active-page highlighting and placeholder actions for connecting your own screens.

thumbnails.alt: Brick Club responsive header with desktop buttons and phone and tablet navigation dropdowns
